review_candidates.title: Network & Infrastructure Operations Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: As a Network & Infrastructure Operations Engineer, you will be part of a high-impact team responsible for managing, securing, and scaling our network infrastructure across private cloud, physical data centers, and multi-cloud environments to ensure peak reliability and performance. Maintain high-capacity links (10 GbE – 100 GbE), routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), throughput, and capacity dashboards while proactively resolving network bottlenecks to hit strict uptime targets. review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: 3+ years of hands-on enterprise, data center, or cloud network operations experience (L2/L3, Ethernet, VLAN, STP, BGP/OSPF, VPNs, routing, and switching). Strong foundation in Linux networking fundamentals (bridges, bonding, iptables, namespaces), paired with hands-on experience in Kubernetes networking (CNIs, service mesh, ingress), OpenStack networking, and awareness of distributed storage connectivity (e.g., Ceph). Proficiency with automation tools such as Python, Ansible, or Terraform. Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure in AWS, Azure, or GCP (VPCs, Direct Connect/ExpressRoute, Transit Gateway).
